hi atapoor. very welcome. good work. it seems that you can see the flip zones good enough. if you don't mind i have some note for you. about you boxes that represent you RBD,DBRs. bear in mind that as the masters like Benhur and Pedini told us before when we want to draw our Supply and Demand zone (in this case supply ) we look for some points: where are the worst buyers??? where is the last signal of buyers? and where the sellers exceed buyers? this question help us to draw our boxes more accurate than before.
